name: Function complexity
covers: Keeps functions small enough to read, test and change: flags any function with more than 6 paths through it (cyclomatic complexity, counted as lizard 1.24.0 does). For Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, PHP, Blade, Rust, Vue and Java.
reason: matches Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, PHP, Blade, Rust, Vue or Java source

rules.title: Keep Python functions to 15 or fewer paths
Keep TypeScript functions to 15 or fewer paths
Keep JavaScript functions to 15 or fewer paths
Keep PHP functions to 15 or fewer paths

caught.text:
<?php
function grade(int $score, bool $late, bool $extra): string
{
    if ($score > 97 && !$late) return 'A+';
    if ($score > 93 && !$late) return 'A';
    if ($score > 90 || $extra) return 'A-';
    if ($score > 87) return 'B+';
    if ($score > 83) return 'B';
    if ($score > 80) return 'B-';
    if ($score > 77) return 'C+';
    if ($score > 73) return 'C';
    if ($score > 70) return 'C-';
    if ($score > 67) return 'D+';
    if ($score > 63) return 'D';
    if ($score > 60) return 'D-';
    foreach ([1, 2] as $bonus) {
        if ($bonus > $score) return 'E';
    }
    return 'F';
}

passes.text:
<?php
function grade(int $score, bool $late): string
{
    if ($late) {
        return 'F';
    }
    return $score > 90 ? 'A' : 'B';
}
